title: Creating Isogenic Disease Models from Stem Cell-Derived Organoids Using CRISPR
author: Celotti, Derks, et al.
materials: In this section we describe vector generation for sgRNA cloning using an inverse PCR reaction. The base vector for this cloning protocol is: pFYF1320 (Addgene #47511, a kind gift from Keith Joung). To clone subsequent sgRNA’s for base editing you can use any sgRNA as template that is based on pFYF1320. This protocol is based on the protocol described by Huang et al.21CRITICAL: We recommend using Personal Protection Equipment (gloves and lab coat) and working in a sterile environment when handling cells or bacteria.30.Order the following universal forward primer/oligo: "/5phos/ GTTTTAGAGCTAGAAATAGCAAGTTAAAATAAGGC. This is a universal primer that will remain constant for all sgRNA cloning reactions in the pFYF1320 backbone.31.Order the reverse primer/oligo by pasting the reverse complement of your designed sgRNA in front of the following universal reverse primer part: CGGTGTTTCGTCCTTTCCACAAG.32.Make the following PCR reaction master mix according to the manufacturer’s protocol. In this case we show the mix for Q5 (NEB). As an alternative to the inverse PCR cloning strategy described above, here, we describe the generation of sgRNA vectors using golden gate BsbI cloning. steps.title: Prepare growth factor stocks
steps.instruction: Make 1‑mL aliquots of each growth factor at the concentrations listed, store at –20 °C (max 2 months).

substeps.instruction: Nicotinamide: dissolve 12.2 g in 100 mL PBS to 1 M.
N‑Acetyl‑L‑cysteine: dissolve 4 g in 49 mL nuclease‑free water to 500 mM.
SB202190 (p38 inhibitor): dissolve 25 mg in 2 mL DMSO to 30 mM.
EGF: dissolve 1 mg in 2 mL 0.1 % BSA/PBS to 500 µg mL⁻¹.
ALK4/5/7 inhibitor (83‑01): dissolve 50 mg in 23.7 mL DMSO to 5 mM.
Prostaglandin E2: dissolve 100 mg in 8 mL DMSO to 10 mM.
Y‑27632 (ROCK inhibitor): dissolve 100 mg in 31.2 mL nuclease‑free water to 10 mM.
FGF10: dissolve 100 µg in 1 mL 0.1 % BSA/PBS to 100 µg mL⁻¹.
FGF7: dissolve 100 µg in 1 mL 0.1 % BSA/PBS to 100 µg mL⁻¹.
HGF: dissolve 100 µg in 1 mL 0.1 % BSA/PBS to 100 µg mL⁻¹.
TGF‑α: dissolve 100 µg in 1 mL 0.1 % BSA/PBS to 100 µg mL⁻¹.
CHIR99021: dissolve 1 mg in 715 µL DMSO to 13 mM.
Gastrin: dissolve 1 mg in 4.8 mL PBS to 0.1 mM.
Aliquot each stock, avoid repeated freeze‑thaw cycles.

steps.title: Prepare DAPI stock
steps.instruction: Make a 2 mg mL⁻¹ DAPI solution and store at 4 °C (up to 3 months).

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 10 mg DAPI in 5 mL nuclease‑free water.

steps.title: Select genome‑editing tool
steps.instruction: Choose a DSB‑free editing method (base editor or prime editor) based on the desired nucleotide change and PAM availability; use SpCas9‑NGG fusion proteins when an NGG PAM exists, otherwise use SpCas9‑NG or SpRY.

steps.title: Choose organoid selection strategy
steps.instruction: Decide which of the three selection methods (e.g., antibiotic, FACS, phenotypic) will be applied after electroporation, as illustrated in Figure 1B.

steps.title: Generate base‑editing sgRNA plasmid (inverse PCR)
steps.instruction: Clone sgRNA into pFYF1320 backbone using inverse PCR, ligation, DpnI digestion, bacterial transformation, colony screening and midiprep.

substeps.instruction: Order universal forward primer: 5ʹ‑/5phos/ GTTTTAGAGCTAGAAATAGCAAGTTAAAATAAGGC‑3ʹ.
Order reverse primer: 5ʹ‑[reverse‑complement of guide]‑CGGTGTTTCGTCCTTTCCACAAG‑3ʹ.

Prepare 20 µL PCR master mix (NEB Q5): 10 µL 5× Q5 buffer, 1 µL 10 mM dNTPs, 2.5 µL 10 µM forward primer, 2.5 µL 10 µM reverse primer, 2 ng template DNA, 0.5 µL Q5 polymerase, 31.5 µL nuclease‑free water.
Run PCR: 98 °C 2 min; 35 × (98 °C 20 s, 60 °C 30 s, 72 °C 1 min 20 s); 72 °C 2 min; hold 4 °C.
Check 5 µL of product on 1 % agarose gel (45 min, 120 V); expect a 2.2 kb band.
Purify PCR product with a PCR cleanup kit, elute in 20 µL.
Measure DNA concentration (Nanodrop).
Set up 10 µL ligation/template‑depletion mix: 1 µL 10× T4 DNA ligase buffer, 1 µL T4 DNA ligase, 1 µL DpnI, 100 ng PCR product, add nuclease‑free water to 10 µL.
Incubate 22 °C 15 min (ligase), 37 °C 30 min (DpnI), 80 °C 20 min (heat‑inactivate DpnI), hold 4 °C.

Transform 4 µL ligation into 50 µL chemically competent DH5α or Mach1 cells: thaw on ice, add DNA, incubate 20 min on ice, heat‑shock 42 °C 45 s, ice 2 min, add 500 µL LB, recover 30‑45 min at 37 °C, plate on ampicillin (100 µg mL⁻¹) plates, incubate overnight.
Pick 3 colonies, inoculate each in 3 mL LB + 100 µg mL⁻¹ ampicillin, grow overnight.
Spin 2 mL of culture, perform miniprep, keep 1 mL glycerol stock at 4 °C.
Sequence plasmids using primer 5ʹ‑GGGCAGGAAGAGGGCCTAT‑3ʹ; align in Benchling (import Addgene #47511, replace 20‑nt guide, create alignment, drag .ab1 files, verify guide insertion).
Midiprep verified plasmid; ensure concentration ≥1 µg µL⁻¹.

steps.title: Generate base‑editing sgRNA plasmid (Golden‑gate BsbI)
steps.instruction: Clone sgRNA into pSPgRNA (Addgene #47108) using BbsI Golden‑gate assembly.

substeps.instruction: Design forward oligo: CACCGNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNN; reverse oligo: NNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNCAAA.
Linearize 1 µg pSPgRNA with 1 µL BbsI, 1 µL T4 polynucleotide kinase, 2 µL 10× FastDigest buffer, water to 20 µL; incubate 37 °C 30 min, then 74 °C 20 min.
Purify linearized backbone (QIAquick PCR kit), elute in 30 µL low‑EDTA TE; measure concentration.
Resuspend each oligo to 100 µM in low‑EDTA TE.

Set up 10 µL annealing mix: 1 µL 10× T4 ligase buffer, 0.5 µL T4 PNK, 1 µL forward 100 µM, 1 µL reverse 100 µM, 6.5 µL water; thermocycle 37 °C 30 min, 95 °C 5 min, ramp down 0.1 °C s⁻¹ to 22 °C, hold.
Ligate 50 ng linearized plasmid with 1 µL annealed duplex, 5 µL Quick ligation buffer, 1 µL Quick ligase, water to 11 µL; incubate 22 °C 15 min.
Transform 3 µL ligation into 50 µL competent cells (as in step 5), plate on ampicillin, incubate overnight.
Screen colonies, miniprep, sequence, and midiprep as described in step 5.

steps.title: Clone prime‑editing sgRNAs (Golden‑gate)
steps.instruction: Assemble pegRNA constructs in pU6‑tevopreq1‑GG‑acceptor (Addgene #174038) using BsaI‑HFv2 Golden‑gate cloning.

substeps.instruction: Order spacer and extension oligos with overhangs: top_spacer CACCG…; bottom_spacer …CTCTAAAACC; top_extension …; bottom_extension ….
Digest 6 µg pU6‑tevopreq1‑GG‑acceptor with 3 µL BsaI‑HFv2, 9 µL 10× Cutsmart, water to 90 µL; incubate 37 °C 30 min.
Run 1 % agarose gel, excise 2.2 kb band, gel‑extract.
Dilute purified backbone to 30 ng µL⁻¹; store –20 °C (≤6 months).
Anneal spacer, scaffold and extension oligos: 1 µL each 100 µM + 23 µL duplex buffer, 95 °C 5 min, ramp down to 22 °C, hold.
Dilute annealed duplexes with 75 µL nuclease‑free water to 1 µM.

Set up 10 µL Golden‑gate reaction: 1 µL linearized backbone (30 ng µL⁻¹), 1 µL annealed spacer, 1 µL annealed scaffold, 1 µL annealed extension, 0.25 µL BsaI‑HFv2, 0.5 µL T4 DNA ligase, 1 µL 10× T4 ligase buffer, 4.25 µL water.
Thermocycle: 22 °C 15 min, 37 °C 15 min, 80 °C 15 min, hold 4 °C.
Transform 4 µL reaction into 50 µL competent cells (as in step 5), plate, incubate.
Screen colonies, miniprep, sequence, and midiprep as in step 5.

steps.title: Electroporate CRISPR tools into organoids
steps.instruction: Prepare organoids, assemble plasmid mix, electroporate with organoid‑type‑specific parameters, and plate for recovery.

substeps.instruction: 72 h before electroporation: add 10 µM Y‑27632 and 1.25 % (v/v) DMSO to organoid expansion medium.
1 h before electroporation: pre‑warm TrypLE + 10 µM Y‑27632 to 37 °C; set centrifuge to 4 °C.
Prepare plasmid DNA mix (per condition) in a 1.5 mL tube:
• Base‑editor experiment: 7.5 µg Cas9‑Base editor, 2.5 µg sgRNA, 3.5 µg PiggyBac transposase, 2.5 µg PiggyBac Hygromycin, optional additional sgRNA (2.5‑3.5 µg). Total ≤25 µg DNA.
• Prime‑editor experiment: 7.5 µg Cas9‑Prime editor, 2.5 µg PEgRNA, 2.5 µg pegRNA, 1.5 µg additional sgRNA, 5 µg PiggyBac transposase, 5 µg PiggyBac Hygromycin.
Include a negative‑control plasmid mix lacking sgRNA or editor.
Inspect organoids under bright‑field; they should be healthy and undifferentiated.
Remove 200‑400 µL medium from each well, add ADF+++ +10 µM Y‑27632, pipette up/down with P1000 to release organoids (coat tip with FCS if needed).
Spin 500 × g 5 min at 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Add 2 mL pre‑warmed TrypLE, resuspend with P1000, incubate 37 °C 5 min (max 15 min).
Check under microscope; aim for fragments of 10‑15 cells. If larger, repeat TrypLE step up to two more times (max total 15 min).
Quench TrypLE with 10 mL ice‑cold ADF+++ +10 µM Y‑27632.
Spin 500 × g 5 min at 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Wash pellet in 4 mL Opti‑MEM +10 µM Y‑27632; spin again 500 × g 5 min at 4 °C.
Resuspend final pellet in 100 µL Opti‑MEM +10 µM Y‑27632 (for 200‑400 µL starting material); keep on ice.
Add plasmid DNA mix to cell suspension, mix gently.
Transfer mixture to a 2 mm gap electroporation cuvette.
Electroporate using organoid‑type parameters:
• Colon: poring pulse 175 V, 5 ms; transfer pulse 20 V, 50 ms; 2 pulses; decay 10 %; polarity ++++/−.
• Endometrium: poring pulse 150 V, 5 ms; transfer pulse 20 V, 50 ms; 2‑5 pulses; decay 10 %; polarity ++++/−.
• Hepatocyte: poring pulse 175 V, 7.5 ms; transfer pulse 20 V, 50 ms; 2‑5 pulses; decay 40 %; polarity ++++/−.
Measure cuvette impedance before pulsing; optimal range 0.035‑0.055 Ω.
Immediately add 400 µL room‑temperature Opti‑MEM +10 µM Y‑27632 to cuvette; incubate 30 min at 20‑25 °C.
Pre‑coat sterile pipette tip with Opti‑MEM, resuspend cells, transfer to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Spin 500 × g 5 min at 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Plate cells densely in 3‑D matrix droplets (240‑320 µL matrix per 200 µL starting material).
Solidify matrix at 37 °C for 15‑30 min.
Add expansion medium +10 µM Y‑27632.
24 h post‑electroporation, examine GFP fluorescence (indicates plasmid delivery).
